{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", sales_df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", sales_df.columns.tolist())
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())
print("\nMissing values:")
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())
print("\nUnique order_ids:")
print(sales_df['order_id'].nunique())

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (sales_df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"\nRefunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Check conversion by channel, stratified by customer segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nConversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(conversion_by_channel_segment)"}
